Version mismatch between kernprof.py and line_profiler

Description

I noticed an issue with the version numbers in the line_profiler package. The version numbers in different parts of the codebase don't match, which is causing problems.

Background: The line_profiler package has version numbers defined in multiple places:
1. In kernprof.py
2. In line_profiler/line_profiler.py
3. In line_profiler/__init__.py

Currently, kernprof.py has version '4.0.3' while line_profiler/line_profiler.py has '4.2.0'. This inconsistency causes issues when trying to use the package.

To reproduce:
```python
import line_profiler
import kernprof
print(f"line_profiler version: {line_profiler.__version__}")
print(f"line_profiler.line_profiler version: {line_profiler.line_profiler.__version__}")
print(f"kernprof version: {kernprof.__version__}")
```

This will show different version numbers, which can lead to compatibility issues and confusion for users.

The comment in kernprof.py even mentions that the version needs to be manually maintained in sync with the other files, but they're currently out of sync.

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and submit the resulting local patch: kernprof.py, line_profiler/line_profiler.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
